title: Universal neural network approximation of symmetric polyconvex energies and envelopes
abstract: arXiv:2610.32598v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Symmetric polyconvexity provides a sufficient condition for weak lower semicontinuity in small-strain elasticity and a tractable lower bound for the relaxation of non-(quasi)convex energies. Since classical algorithms for computing such functions can be computationally expensive, neural network approximations have recently emerged as an alternative. A central difficulty with establishing such neural network based approaches for symmetric polyconvexity is the additional monotonicity property. As we show, the corresponding weight restrictions on ReLU-based input-convex networks do not yield universal approximation of the lifted representers. Here, we introduce symmetric polyconvex neural networks (SPCNNs) for constitutive modeling and approximation of symmetric polyconvex envelopes. The deep architecture combines convexity with the monotonicity required of a representer in the space of minors. We prove a universal approximation theorem f

translated_title: 对称多凸能量与包络的通用神经网络逼近
translated_abstract: 对称多凸性为小应变弹性理论中的弱下半连续性提供了充分条件，并为非（拟）凸能量的松弛提供了一个可处理的下界。由于计算此类函数的经典算法可能计算代价高昂，神经网络近似近来已成为一种替代方案。在为对称多凸性建立此类基于神经网络的方法时，一个核心困难在于额外的单调性要求。正如我们所证明的，在基于ReLU的输入凸网络上施加相应的权重限制并不能实现对提升后的表示子的通用逼近。本文引入了对称多凸神经网络（SPCNNs），用于本构建模以及对称多凸包络的逼近。该深度架构将凸性与表示子在子式空间中所要求的单调性相结合。我们证明了一个通用逼近定理……
tldr: 本文提出对称多凸神经网络（SPCNNs），通过在深度架构中同时融合凸性与子式空间所需的单调性，首次实现了对对称多凸能量及其包络的通用逼近，为弹性力学中的本构建模提供了高效的神经网络替代方案。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Symmetric Polyconvex Neural Networks (SPCNNs), which combine convexity with the required monotonicity in the space of minors within a deep architecture, achieving universal approximation of symmetric polyconvex energies and envelopes as an efficient neural network alternative for constitutive modeling in elasticity.
